source_query: select id,course,seq,acip,wylie,english,raw from corpus_segments where course='C05' and seq=234;
hgm_query: select wylie,tibetan,acip,hgm_gloss,tier,hgm_source,corpus_courses,corpus_n_segments,raw from entries where wylie in ('de''i phyir','phung po','cha','cha can','ngo bo tha dad pa','cung zad','nga','rtog pas','brten nas','bzhag pa','tsam','rang gi ngo bos','grub pa','med') order by wylie,id;
corpus_query: select course,seq,acip,wylie,english from corpus_segments where course <> 'C13' and ((course='C16' and seq=811) or (course='ILL' and seq=1114) or (course='SPF' and seq=40)) order by course,seq;
